## Guides

- [iPhone storage guides](https://klenzer.online/guides/)
- [iPhone storage full: what to do](https://klenzer.online/guides/iphone-storage-full/): Your iPhone says storage is full. See what is using the space, the quickest ways to free it, and what to do when deleting does not help.
- [iPhone System Data storage: what it is and how to reduce it](https://klenzer.online/guides/iphone-system-data-storage/): System Data is the grey part of your iPhone storage bar. Learn what it contains, why it grows, and which fixes actually reduce it.
- [Why is my iPhone storage still full after deleting everything?](https://klenzer.online/guides/iphone-storage-full-after-deleting/): Deleted photos and apps but the storage bar did not change? Learn why, and how to get the space back, from Recently Deleted to restarting.
- [WhatsApp is filling my iPhone storage: how to free space](https://klenzer.online/guides/whatsapp-storage-iphone/): WhatsApp photos, videos and voice notes can use many GB. Find the biggest chats, clear large files, and stop media saving automatically.
- [Why is my iPhone storage full when I have iCloud?](https://klenzer.online/guides/iphone-storage-full-with-icloud/): iCloud storage and iPhone storage are separate. Learn why your phone can be full with plenty of iCloud space, and how to set iCloud Photos correctly.
- [Is 64GB enough for an iPhone?](https://klenzer.online/guides/is-64gb-enough-for-iphone/): Is 64GB enough for iPhone? A plain guide to what fits in 64GB, 128GB and 256GB, with photo and video size maths and who should pick which.
- [What happens when your iPhone storage is full?](https://klenzer.online/guides/what-happens-when-iphone-storage-is-full/): A full iPhone can stop taking photos, installing updates and saving data. See the exact problems, the warning signs, and how to free enough space.
- [iPhone storage full and you can't delete photos](https://klenzer.online/guides/cant-delete-photos-iphone-storage-full/): Photos will not delete from your iPhone, or storage will not free up? Check synced photos, iCloud, Recently Deleted, and a stuck phone, step by step.
- [How to free up space on iPhone](https://klenzer.online/guides/how-to-free-up-space-on-iphone/): Free up space on your iPhone fast. Ten fixes ranked by how much space they usually recover, from offloading apps to clearing downloads and videos.
- [How to clear storage on iPhone](https://klenzer.online/guides/how-to-clear-storage-on-iphone/): Clear iPhone storage by category: apps, photos, Messages, Safari, downloads and System Data. What each clean-up does and what you keep.
- [How many photos can an iPhone hold?](https://klenzer.online/guides/how-many-photos-fit-on-64gb-128gb-256gb-iphone/): Rough photo counts for 64GB, 128GB and 256GB iPhones, with the maths shown and the reasons your real number will be lower.
- [How much storage do you need on an iPhone?](https://klenzer.online/guides/how-much-storage-do-i-need-on-iphone/): Pick the right iPhone storage size by how you use your phone: photos, video, games and iCloud. A simple table and how to check your current use.
